channel.title: Tampa Bay News Monitor
channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [WFLA News Channel 8] Air Force officer runs a mile for every Sept. 11 victim
item.description: Hanna Born, who was in a Pentagon daycare on 9/11, names each person as her strides add up.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Interactive: The case for and against Flock cameras
item.description: Flock Safety cameras are seemingly everywhere — but what are these automated license plate readers actually recording, and is the technology being abused?

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] PSTA awarded $16.5 million federal grant for new Tampa Bay Ferry vessel
item.description: The Pinellas Suncoast Transit Authority (PSTA) has been awarded a $16.5 million federal grant to purchase a new vessel for the Tampa Bay Ferry service, the agency announced Friday.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Study links lower early-life sugar intake to reduced cancer risk
item.description: Research on postwar Britain suggests lower sugar intake in infancy may be tied to lower cancer risk and healthier diets later in life.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Autopsy shows Tennessee National Guard fatally shot 20-year-old armed man in the back
item.description: Autopsy shows Tennessee National Guard fatally shot 20-year-old armed man in the back, contradicting accounts by law enforcement.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Fed Chair Warsh signals rate hikes may be needed with inflation still elevated
item.description: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh said Friday that inflation is still too high and suggested the central bank may have to raise interest rates in the coming months.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Apple’s first foldable iPhone may arrive with $2,000 price tag
item.description: The expected foldable iPhone launch would mark Apple’s entry into a growing but still niche smartphone category.

item.title: [WATCHLIST: hurricane] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Clearwater reimbursed by FEMA for $9.3M so far; city continues recovery 2 years after hurricanes
item.description: Nearly two years after Hurricanes Helene and Milton devastated parts of the Tampa Bay area, the City of Clearwater is still working through the FEMA reimbursement process for storm-related damage — with $9.3 million currently sought.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Judge says states lack time to comply with Trump's new mail voting rules
item.description: Federal courts again blocked parts of Trump’s push to restrict mail voting, setting up another likely Supreme Court battle before midterms.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] AMC Theatres bringing back Dolly Parton films after her death
item.description: “Steel Magnolias” and “The Best Little Whorehouse in Texas” will return to about 200 AMC theaters nationwide Friday.

item.title: [WATCHLIST: county commission] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Tampa Bay Rays ballpark vote: Hillsborough County commissioners to decide on $800M funding plan
item.description: The Hillsborough County Board of Commissioners is set to vote Friday on nearly $800 million in public funding for the Tampa Bay Rays' proposed new ballpark.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Trump to honor Artemis II astronauts with Congressional Space Medal
item.description: Artemis II astronauts will receive Congressional Space Medals after becoming the first crew in decades to travel deep into space.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Catastrophic floods in Nepal and China kill over 500; 90 Americans missing
item.description: Rescuers in Nepal and China are racing to find survivors after deadly Himalayan floods triggered by a glacier collapse.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Great Labor Day sales at Lowe's, Home Depot, Macy's, Wayfair and more
item.description: If you've been waiting to buy an appliance, mattress, indoor or outdoor furniture, or clothing, Labor Day sales bring the best discounts of the summer.
